text:
maya: Heads up — after today's runtime v2.3.7 rollout we started seeing tenant-specific p99 spikes (~800ms increase) for a small cohort. Support ticket #4521.

support-bot: Ticket 4521 attached logs: https://redwood/support/4521 :rotating_light:

kevin: I see the spike correlated with the version_override flag being set for that cohort — suspected cold KV cache path. Seen this before with eager vs lazy kvcache init.

ash: Can you paste the tail of the slow request traces? I want to see where time is spent.

sre-oncall: Pasting one trace (anonymized):
```
2026-03-17T10:12:03Z TRACE request_id=abc123 tenant=acme stage=decode 12ms
2026-03-17T10:12:03Z TRACE request_id=abc123 tenant=acme kvcache.lookup miss 512ms
2026-03-17T10:12:04Z TRACE request_id=abc123 stage=gen_token 5ms
2026-03-17T10:12:04Z TRACE request_id=abc123 total 545ms
```

sre-oncall: Notice the kvcache.lookup miss taking ~500ms — that's the tail.

liz: Repro steps I used against canary:
```
curl -X POST https://canary-infer.internal/models/x:predict -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{"input":"..."}' -v
```
Repro is intermittent; seems more likely when requests hit hosts that were zeroed since restart.

kevin: Hypothesis: v2.3.7 introduced version override that bypasses persistent kvcache initialization for memory-savings. For cold workers we pay the lookup penalty.

maya: Customer noticed latency regression only after we rotated instances (scale/up). They also reported error 429s early but those subsided.

ash: Quick mitigation options:
- rollback cohort to v2.3.6 (fast)
- enable eager kvcache warmup on canary hosts (config flip)
- route traffic off warmless hosts until warmed

ops-bot: Rollback job scheduled: rollout/rollback v2.3.6 -> starting in 3m (owner: kevin)

kevin: I'm running a targeted rollback for the tenant and starting a synthetic warm job to prime KV on affected hosts. Command:
```
kubectl exec -n runtime deploy/warmer -- /app/warm_kv.sh --tenants acme --parallel 10
```

sre-oncall: Also let's bisect the changeset to be precise: run canary split 10% v2.3.7 vs 90% v2.3.6 and capture p95/p99 for both. If v2.3.7 >= 2.x p99 then we have config bug.

liz: I'll instrument a short-lived canary A/B and collect traces. Assigning myself.

maya: Ownership: kevin (rollback + warm), liz (bisect + traces), ash (possible config patch for kv init). Support to update customer.

support-bot: Customer updated: "Thanks, appreciate the quick turnaround" :thumbsup:

kevin: Rollback completed for tenant, p99 returned to baseline in ~6 minutes after warmers ran. Will keep monitoring.

sre-oncall: Postmortem TODOs:
- revert version_override default or gate behind opt-in
- add metric for kvcache miss tail latency per host
- add automated warm-on-start for scaled-up pool

maya: Great. Marking this thread resolved for now — will open follow-up issue to track config change. Thanks team :heart:
